This is covered by LRN-019, which says to model explicitly ordered work sequentially rather than as unsupported parallel branches. GW-04 and GW-05 also support using parallel gateways only when the described behavior warrants the)

same as LRN-010 (The description says the employee continues skill development while receiving feedback, and the missing flows show divergence around parallel branches and their synchronization. This is already covered by learned guideline LRN-010.)

same as LRN-020 (The generated labels include an unsupported outcome and alter or broaden details stated in the description. LRN-020 already advises preserving meaningful event or activity details in labels, so this guideline expresses the same principle.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description explicitly orders activities or says that work continues until a stated condition is reached: Model the activities in the stated sequence, and do not represent them as parallel or mutually exclusive branches unless the description explicitly supports concurrency or a decision.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a later phase begins only when a milestone or other condition is reached, after ongoing or repeated work

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that several activities are all required before a later activity or outcome: Model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize all branches with a parallel gateway before the later activity or outcome.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that multiple activities occur concurrently and that a later activity or outcome depends on their completion

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description distinguishes an event or activity by its action, actor, object, recipient, or another meaningful qualifier: Label each BPMN element so that it preserves those stated details without substituting a broader or different meaning.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an event or activity with a meaningful action, actor, object, recipient, or outcome

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a successful outcome includes concrete actions or adjustments: Model each explicitly stated action or adjustment as part of the outcome; do not infer parallel branches unless the description establishes concurrent or independently required work.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a successful outcome includes concrete actions or adjustments

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description distinguishes a process trigger, an activity, or an outcome from other stages of the process: Label each BPMN element according to the meaning of its corresponding described trigger, activity, or outcome; do not substitute a different stage or its purpose or result.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description distinguishes a process trigger, activity, or outcome from other stages of the process
